meta.description: Authored, not auto-activated. Webhook-triggered, on-demand ROVER expand: the app's /api/rover/expand POSTs { approvalId, vtaNumber } here; this single, polite fetch pulls the public VTADetails page (browser-like UA, on the VPN / AU egress) and POSTs its HTML to {APP_BASE_URL}/api/rover/ingest/ with the bearer token — the app extracts the inline PDFs, parses, archives and gates (PENDING). The ingest result is returned to the original caller via Respond to Webhook. CRITICAL: the app never fetches ROVER itself; it only triggers this workflow. Single fetch (no paging, no grid), so no anti-bot concerns beyond the browser-like UA. Set APP_BASE_URL + ROVER_INGEST_TOKEN on the n8n host. See ops/n8n/README.md. active:false.
